content:
deploybot: Safety valve triggered: canary EU p95 latency > 1.25s for model-redwood-v3.2.3 — rolling hold suggested :warning:

lina: saw it, thanks. can we get quick perf snapshot + recent deploys?

raj: grabbing traces now. initial look: 80% of excess on kv-cache miss path. could be model kernel change in 3.2.3.

sam: i pushed the 3.2.3 quant kernel patch earlier in the window, agreed likely related.

olivia: customer-facing impact? any errors or just latency?

raj: no error spike, just latency and a slight increase in 5xx on a small subset of edges. p95 up, p99 unchanged.

ana (ops): @lina we have a scheduled change window + 30m still — prefer manual coordination rather than autopilot revert.

lina: leaning manual staged rollback -> pin to 3.2.2 for EU canary then evaluate. want to avoid global auto-revert unless it deteriorates. :thumbsup:

deploybot: note: autopilot rollback threshold is p95 > 1.5s for 3 consecutive minutes (not reached). current hold mode enabled.

sam: manual steps I'd run: 1) pin canary routing to 3.2.2 2) shift 40% traffic back 3) monitor KV-cache fill and p95 4) if green, roll to 100% and unpin. quick commands:

```bash
# pin version for canary route
redwoodctl route set --route canary-eu --model-model-redwood --version 3.2.2 --force
# adjust traffic slice
redwoodctl traffic set --route canary-eu --percent 40
```

raj: echo that. i'll watch dashboards and run a short perf replay from late-night traces.

olivia: i'll draft a short comms note if we end up pinning broader: "Investigating increased latency after kernel patch. Rolling back canary in EU and monitoring. No customer data impact." keep it minimal.

lina: agreed. who will update release notes / changelog? we should add an entry about the kernel opt and note rollback decision.

sam: i'll PR a one-line to release-notes and link it here.

ana (ops): timeline? can ops get a heads-up 5m before we flip to 100%?

lina: yes. target: pin now -> 40% within 3m -> observe 10m -> escalate to 100% if p95 drops under 0.9s. ops, prepare rollback ticket in case autopilot triggers.

deploybot: scheduled hold applied. will suppress autopilot if manual pin is applied within 10m.

raj: traces incoming. initial replay shows p95 drop to 0.92s after switching to 3.2.2 in local sim. promising.

sam: pin applied to canary-eu, set to 40%. (ran commands above)

olivia: drafting comms: "We observed elevated latency in EU canary after a kernel optimization shipped in v3.2.3. We've pinned the canary to v3.2.2 while we validate. We'll update if broader action required." anyone want edits?

lina: good. add expected ETA for next update: +15m.

ana (ops): ready for the 100% flip when you call it. I'll also open a fast-track incident channel if we see regression.

raj: dashboard shows p95 trending down to 0.88s at 6m after pin. 5xxs normalized. continue observe.

sam: planning: after green window we'll coordinate a follow-up patch reverting the quant kernel change and schedule a re-roll with canary ramp.

lina: ok team — action items captured: sam pinned and PRs; raj monitoring; olivia comms; ana on standby for exec; i'll mark release notes and close loop after 30m. thanks. :white_check_mark:

deploybot: Update: hold cleared automatically after manual pin detection. Logging event for audit: event_id=ev-6172839450-1

lina: final note -> we'll add postmortem blameless entry and include perf test for kv-cache misses in CI.
